program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((grey-cells (find-color g 5))
                  (n (length grey-cells))
                  (div-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                      (define vals
                                        (for/list ((c (range 0 w))) (at g r c)))
                                      (or
                                        (andmap (lambda (v) (or (= 5 v) (zero? v)))
                                                vals)
                                        (> (count-if (lambda (v) (zero? v)) vals)
                                           (quotient w 2))))
                                    (range 0 h)))
                  (div-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                      (define vals
                                        (for/list ((r (range 0 h))) (at g r c)))
                                      (or
                                        (andmap (lambda (v) (or (= 5 v) (zero? v)))
                                                vals)
                                        (> (count-if (lambda (v) (zero? v)) vals)
                                           (quotient h 2))))
                                    (range 0 w)))
                  (cr (quotient (- h 1) 2))
                  (cc (quotient (- w 1) 2))
                  (vertical-track (>= (length div-cols) 2))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) 7)))
             (if vertical-track
                 (let* ((g1 (reduce (lambda (gr c)
                                      (reduce (lambda (g2 r) (set-cell g2 r c 0))
                                              gr
                                              (range 0 h)))
                                    base
                                    (list (- cc 1) (+ cc 1))))
                        (g2 (reduce (lambda (gr r)
                                      (reduce (lambda (g3 c) (set-cell g3 r c 0))
                                              gr
                                              (range 0 w)))
                                    g1
                                    div-rows))
                        (half (quotient (- n 1) 2)))
                   (reduce (lambda (gr i)
                             (let ((r (+ (- cr half) i)))
                               (if (and (>= r 0) (< r h)) (set-cell gr r cc 5) gr)))
                           g2
                           (range 0 n)))
                 (let* ((g1 (reduce (lambda (gr r)
                                      (reduce (lambda (g2 c) (set-cell g2 r c 0))
                                              gr
                                              (range 0 w)))
                                    base
                                    (list (- cr 1) (+ cr 1))))
                        (g2 (reduce (lambda (gr c)
                                      (reduce (lambda (g3 r) (set-cell g3 r c 0))
                                              gr
                                              (range 0 h)))
                                    g1
                                    div-cols))
                        (half (quotient (- n 1) 2)))
                   (reduce (lambda (gr i)
                             (let ((c (+ (- cc half) i)))
                               (if (and (>= c 0) (< c w)) (set-cell gr cr c 5) gr)))
                           g2
                           (range 0 n))))))))
